items.label: ✦Soft & Airy Knit Fabric
items.value: Mock neck tops made from a lightweight, stretchy breathable knit that feels smooth and soft against the skin. Ideal for spring and summer, especially in air-conditioned environments.

items.label: ✦Lightweight Mock Neck
items.value: Designed with a refined mock neck that offers light neck coverage without feeling tight or heavy. Enhances the neckline for a longer, slimmer appearance while adding a polished, elegant touch that's perfect for spring and summer wear.

items.label: ✦Breathable Cap Sleeve Design
items.value: The cap sleeves softly cover the upper arms and promote airflow, keeping you cool and comfortable during summer days, while enhancing the sweater’s silhouette for a dressier look than basic knit tops.

items.label: ✦Versatile Styling
items.value: The short sleeve sweater pairs easily with shorts, skirts, jeans, or slacks. Layer under a blazer or cardigan for work, or wear alone for a casual everyday summer outfit.

items.label: ✦Occasions
items.value: Simple yet stylish tops for daily wear, at home, in the office, business casual settings, vacations, resorts, cruises, running errands, shopping, date nights, or casual outings. A must-have summer wardrobe essential.
